3852|2|4|700.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
3852|2|4|700.evidence: 9/14 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

3852|2|4|700.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
3852|2|4|700.evidence: USI median +0.234 over 14 corners (8 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

3852|2|4|700.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
3852|2|4|700.evidence: 40 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

3852|2|4|700.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 3 stops (0 both-axle, 0 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.28) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
